test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities is associated with synthesizing classical and modern Indian dance through a theatre group called Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanti Bardhan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shanti Bardhan** is associated with synthesizing classical and modern Indian dance through **Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe.**
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a **Manipuri dancer **and **choreographer.**
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is a** Kathak **dancer and choreographer.
 
• **Remo Fernandes** is a **musician and choreographer **known for his work in Bollywood films.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Classical Indian dance forms include **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, and Sattriya.**
 
• Modern Indian dance forms include **Bollywood, contemporary, and fusion styles.**
 
• **Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe** was founded in Kolkata in the **1950s** by Shanti Bardhan.
